# openfluids

> Open tools for fluid flows: state-of-the-art methods, ultra-modern low-memory code, for humans and agents.

Open code for fluid mechanics.

## Stability

- [linstabpy](https://github.com/openfluids/linstabpy): linear stability and resolvent analysis ([docs](https://linstabpy.vercel.app/))
- [nekStab](https://github.com/nekStab/nekStab): stability and bifurcation for Nek5000

## Analysis

- [openmodalpy](https://github.com/openfluids/openmodalpy): nine modal decompositions, one API
- [dynachaos](https://github.com/openfluids/dynachaos): Lyapunov exponents, recurrence, entropy ([site](https://openfluids.github.io/dynachaos/))
- [fftkit](https://github.com/openfluids/fftkit): spectra, one FFT API over eight backends
- [dsgbr](https://github.com/openfluids/dsgbr): peaks in noisy, sloped spectra
- [chaos-atlas](https://github.com/openfluids/chaos-atlas): chaotic systems in the browser ([site](https://openfluids.github.io/chaos-atlas/))

## Solvers

- [dolfinx-rans](https://github.com/openfluids/dolfinx-rans): RANS turbulence in DOLFINx

## Runs

- [hpckit](https://github.com/openfluids/hpckit): Slurm runs from a local checkout
- [quadros](https://github.com/openfluids/quadros): snapshots to frames and videos

## Sites

- [machine-made](https://machine-made.github.io/)
- [openfluids](https://openfluids.github.io/)
- [BoringQuantSystems](https://boringquantsystems.github.io/)
